title: Exclusive Key Lime Pie Show and Tasting in Key West
requirements: All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Emotional Support Animals and Pets are Not Allowed
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: A quick culinary adventure awaits at the Exclusive Key Lime Pie Show in the vibrant heart of Mallory Square. In just 30 minutes, discover the secrets to crafting the iconic Key lime pie, from mastering the graham cracker crust to achieving that perfect, creamy filling. After the lively demonstration, savor a slice of the world-famous pie, made without any green food coloring. Plus, take home the official recipe card to recreate this delicious treat at home, ensuring your taste of Key West lasts well beyond your visit.
